desc: 蓝调清新宠物补钙套系：奶源卖点、症状痛点、配方轮盘与参数信任收口
name: 犬用乳钙强健骨骼款

shots.intent: 长图首屏三秒承接点击，一句话讲清核心补钙卖点与适用生命阶段
shots.textZone: top center: kicker on a warm yellow #F6C453 highlight bar, two-line headline below, one short audience tag line under the headline

shots.intent: 用一个原料级卖点建立品质感，元素圆标预告配方骨架
shots.textZone: upper-middle headline with yellow highlight bar; row of three circle tags below

shots.intent: 用症状自检卡片放大问题，让宠物主对号入座
shots.textZone: banner headline near the top; one short label plus a two-line note at the bottom of each card

shots.intent: 俯视萌宠目光直击情绪，环绕气泡点名缺钙危害
shots.textZone: short two-line tags inside the four floating bubbles

shots.intent: 用配方轮盘讲清成分结构，传递科学配比感
shots.textZone: one short ingredient tag per sector, arranged around the circle

shots.intent: 左萌宠右利益点，讲清补得进、留得住的机制
shots.textZone: two-line charcoal headline above; three pill titles with two short support lines each on the right column

shots.intent: 规格参数与喂食说明一次讲清，消除喂法与成分疑虑
shots.textZone: spec table label cells below the product, plus two short usage lines in charcoal

shots.intent: 微距实拍证明包装与做工，佐证产品真实可信
四个圈形徽章传递品牌承诺收口，直观降低下单顾虑
shots.textZone: two-line promise tags inside the four circle badges

style.backgroundSystem: two-tone vertical split of cloud-blue #A9D9EB and lake-blue #7FC3DB for the hero screen; clean white #FFFFFF and soft grey-white #FAFAFA panels for infographic, spec and trust screens
style.iconSystem: thin-outline circle badges, flat rounded pill labels and small yellow underline bars in warm yellow #F6C453 only
style.lightingSystem: bright soft even studio lighting, minimal shadow, soft contact shadows under the product, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh clean pet-health ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud-blue #A9D9EB, lake-blue #7FC3DB, clean white #FFFFFF, charcoal text #2D2D2D and one warm sunshine-yellow accent #F6C453; bright soft even studio lighting with minimal shadow and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif headline lettering; consistent rounded pill labels, thin-outline circle badges and small yellow underline bars; clean high-end product photography mixed with flat minimal infographic elements; stable upright product at a consistent slight 3/4 hero angle and scale; balanced breathing margins inside every frame with no reserved gaps; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: product upright, stable slight 3/4 hero angle and consistent scale across the set
style.surfaceSystem: round marble pedestal in #F2F0EC with soft grey veining for the hero; flat clean board surfaces elsewhere
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headline lettering, charcoal #2D2D2D on light panels and #FFFFFF on blue panels
